rules: Only an explicitly assigned own displayAliases entry on a graph Output with outputPath replaces the small visible return-path subtitle with the literal model output. The main title is the actual alias.
Absent alias preserves real compact return paths, including legitimate n_ and UUID-looking user keys, nested key/index segments, scalar keys, and whole-value return.
Aliases on non-Output nodes keep existing subtitles. Output without declared path keeps existing kind subtitle. Opaque evidence takes existing priority.
Source bytes, source/IR digests, canonical outputPath, all sourceFacts, SVG metadata and title identity retain full actual return evidence.
Multiple aliased outputs retain their distinct titles and original facts; no fabricated ordinal or machine-origin inference.
